title: 替你繫的那一隻
subject: two volunteers at a dawn bird-ringing station on the Guandu wetland in autumn migration, weighing warblers in cloth bags; she fits the rings, he keeps the logbook and writes her initial beside every bird she rings, and on the last morning of the season she rings one and says it is for him
caption: 1970s Taiwan campus folk (xiaoyuan minge) revival, unplugged and earnest. Two fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitars in open interlocking parts; a soft harmonica answering the end of each verse line; a light upright bass walking under the chorus; a hand tambourine only on the last chorus. Plain close-miked recording in a small dry room, warm tape tone, no studio gloss. Clear young male tenor, plain and sincere, gentle straight-tone delivery, a soft female harmony joining on the last chorus. 84 BPM, D major. Shy, warm, hopeful. No drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no ballad string section, no R&B runs.
lyrics:
[Intro - two fingerpicked acoustic guitars, harmonica]

[Verse 1]
清晨五點 關渡的天還沒亮
網子上掛著 一身露水的柳鶯
你把牠輕輕 放進小布袋
秤一秤 九克半

[Pre-Chorus]
我在記錄本 寫下牠的翅長
再偷偷在旁邊 寫一個字

[Chorus]
每一隻你繫上腳環的鳥
我都在本子邊邊 寫一個芸
你問我 那個字是什麼記號
我說 是今天的風向

[Verse 2]
十月的北風 吹過紅樹林
你的手很穩 我的字有點抖
保溫瓶的咖啡 我們輪著喝
你說 牠們明天就要往南走

[Chorus]
每一隻你繫上腳環的鳥
我都在本子邊邊 寫一個芸
整本翻過去 密密麻麻
你終於笑著問 這陣風怎麼都不停

[Bridge]
這一季最後一個早晨
你從布袋裡 拿出一隻灰灰的小鳥
繫好腳環 放在我手心
你說 這一隻 是替你繫的

[Chorus - female harmony joins]
最後一隻你繫上腳環的鳥
你拿走我的筆 在旁邊寫字
不是芸 是我的名字
明年秋天 牠會回來 我們也還在這裡

[Outro - harmonica, last guitar chord rings]
